peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 9.7% above its local comparables; 88 of 102 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (95.4): 6.9 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 103 of 108 similar developments with a figure. Context, not scored: resales in 100% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $914,000 ($1,823 psf, 495–516 sq ft; 12 resales, Sep 2025–Aug 2026); 7 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,831 psf (range $1,746–1,901); 0.4% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $4,000 less. 2-bedroom: median $1,420,000 ($2,008 psf, 656–850 sq ft; 25 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,878 psf (range $1,578–2,000); 6.9% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $92,000 more. 3-bedroom: median $2,300,000 ($2,325 psf, 925–1,130 sq ft; 10 resales, Sep 2025–Aug 2026); 5 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,896 psf (range $1,586–2,176); 22.6% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $424,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Bartley MRT about 230 m, Tai Seng MRT about 950 m; closer than 90 of 116 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest Paya Lebar Methodist Girls' School (Primary) about 820 m; more than 14 of 116 similar developments (the same as 24). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 2 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 590 m), more than 7 of 116 similar developments (the same as 19); nearest hawker centre Woodleigh Village Hawker Centre about 1,180 m; nearest park Greenway South about 410 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: No other condo development sold new homes within 2 km. Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 107 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 0 new sales and 506 resales (506 purchases); new sales were 0% of these purchases. Subsales (33) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 506 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 83 of 116 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 506 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 609 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−16.9%). Planning-area private resales −15.2%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
